home.title: Transform Your Travel Plans into Perfect Itineraries
home.subtitle: Stop spending hours planning. Just list where you want to go, and our AI creates a professional day-by-day itinerary with images, maps, ticket links, and cost estimates - in minutes.

smartOrganization.title: Intelligent Route Planning
smartOrganization.description: Our AI groups nearby attractions together, minimizing travel time and maximizing your experience at each destination.

richContent.title: Complete Information
richContent.description: Get detailed descriptions, stunning images, direct ticket booking links, and accurate cost estimates for every attraction.

multiLanguage.title: Your Language, Your Way
multiLanguage.description: Generate itineraries in English, Portuguese, Spanish, or French - share them easily with travel companions.

step1.title: List Your Dream Destinations
step1.description: Simply type the attractions you want to visit. Add notes like 'Eiffel Tower and nearby cafes' or specify which day you prefer each place.

step2.title: AI Creates Your Perfect Plan
step2.description: Our intelligent agents analyze locations, optimize routes, and research detailed information for each attraction - all automatically.

step3.title: Download Your Professional Itinerary
step3.description: Get a beautifully formatted document with day-by-day schedules, high-quality images, interactive maps, and everything you need.

interactiveFlow.title: You Stay in Control
interactiveFlow.description: When you don't specify day preferences, our AI groups attractions by location to minimize travel time. Before proceeding, you'll review and approve the proposed organization - or request changes until it's exactly how you want it.
interactiveFlow.note: If you specify days for all attractions (e.g., 'Day 1: Louvre'), the AI follows your plan directly without needing approval.

colosseum.name: Colosseum
colosseum.description: The iconic ancient amphitheater that once hosted gladiatorial contests. Built between 70-80 AD, it could hold up to 80,000 spectators.
colosseum.ticketInfo: Combined ticket with Roman Forum and Palatine Hill

forum.name: Roman Forum
forum.description: The heart of ancient Rome, featuring ruins of important government buildings, temples, and public spaces.

trevi.name: Trevi Fountain
trevi.description: Baroque masterpiece and Rome's largest fountain. Tradition says throwing a coin ensures your return to Rome.

pantheon.name: Pantheon
pantheon.description: Ancient Roman temple with the world's largest unreinforced concrete dome, now a church housing Raphael's tomb.

vatican.name: Vatican Museums
vatican.description: One of the world's greatest art collections, culminating in the magnificent Sistine Chapel with Michelangelo's ceiling.

stpeters.name: St. Peter's Basilica
stpeters.description: The world's largest church and center of Christianity, featuring Michelangelo's Pietà and stunning Renaissance architecture.
